Inspect original/output project/property views and save-version evidence separately; record actual load/errors, resolved and missing dependencies, authorized build inputs/results, and controlled behavior under independently established fixtures with reset/error/timeout conditions. No native outcome is currently predictable from this text-only proposal; freeze native expectations independently before any later native validation, or retain unverified/unexecuted statuses.

Report separate artifact/text, answer, grounding, reader-fidelity and native outcomes; false/unsupported extras or contradictions require independent claim adjudication.

Inherit paired lineage uncertainty/missing-pair rules, no interval for one lineage.

isolation.rule: Future withheld cases/keys require separate commissioned sources, duplicate/variant adjudication, whole-lineage allocation, custodian and executed role-specific denial/allowed-access/leakage checks. Public history and evaluator paths provide no concealment. Store readiness alone does not establish case allocation/run isolation.

integration_after_review.rule: A separate specifically ordered integration appends WP1, qualified coverage and bounded controls/checker inventory/results to these five files only; retain historical pins and use a new addendum. Any later preparation index update needs its own reviewed scope. This proposal changes no existing file. Independent review precedes integration or any real edit; owner method acceptance precedes product work; evaluator changes need Policymaker order and separate verifier.

checker.boundary: Exact hash/structured checks and in-memory malformed controls are not independent truth or an agent/tool benchmark. Free prose is reviewed semantically; C1 is not closed by keywords, integrity hashes or this checker.
